summary: OTP bypass bug fix for guest checkout flows - ALL TESTS PASSED. Verified that guest users with guestMobile in localStorage can skip OTP verification in PharmacyCheckout, UnifiedCheckout, and MangoCheckout. The fix correctly: 1) Shows 'Phone verified via login' badge, 2) Hides OTP input fields and Send OTP button, 3) Enables Continue button, 4) Auto-fills patient name and phone from localStorage.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage simulation: guestMobile=9876543210, patientName=Test Guest User, pharmacyCart/labCart items
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP bypass fix verified working in all 3 checkout flows. The fix uses isGuestVerified = Boolean(localStorage.getItem('guestMobile') || localStorage.getItem('userPhone')) to detect if guest already verified via login OTP. Routes tested: /pharmacy/checkout (PharmacyCheckout), /unified-checkout (UnifiedCheckout), /mango/checkout (MangoCheckout).

bugs_fixed.bug: Guest users asked for OTP again during checkout despite already verifying via OTP at guest login
bugs_fixed.fix_description: Added isGuestVerified check that reads guestMobile from localStorage to auto-bypass OTP verification
Changed auth.verified to auth.isVerified to match useUnifiedAuth hook return value
Changed auth.verifyOtp(phone, otp) to auth.verifyOtp(otp) - hook only needs OTP, phone stored internally
